temp.instructions: How warm is it outside? Cold is under 10 °C, Mild 10 to 22 °C, Hot over 22 °C; go by how it feels when no temperature is given.

humidity.instructions: How humid is the air? Dry is under 40% relative humidity, Normal 40 to 70%, Humid over 70%; sticky air is Humid.

raining.instructions: Is it raining, or about to?

criteria.true: Rain is falling, or the state says it is about to start
criteria.false: No rain, and none expected soon
